chaining: pairs with an agent after a key; the scarce link is the key plus the ':free' suffix, because a zero-priced id without the suffix is a different quota class

limits.value: free model ids (ending in :free), by credits purchased all time: fewer than 10 credits, 20 requests per minute and 50 requests per day; at least 10 credits, 20 requests per minute and 1000 requests per day. The daily window is the UTC day, the 50 a day is a total across free models, and extra accounts or API keys do not change the caps because capacity is governed globally

free_tier.stated: free-model request caps for model IDs ending in :free, selected by all-time credits purchased: 20 requests per minute with 50 requests per day below 10 credits, and 20 requests per minute with 1000 requests per day from 10 credits
free_tier.notes: GET /api/v1/key reports the daily counter as free_model_daily_requests with a limit field; the per-minute limit is not reported there.
